preferred: Supplier's total liability capped at no less than 2x the annual fees
fallback: Cap of at least 1x the annual fees
condition: Fallback is not acceptable where the annual value is more than ₹1 crore

preferred: Supplier indemnifies Veridian against third-party IP infringement claims and data breaches
fallback: Supplier indemnifies against third-party IP infringement claims only
red_line: Veridian indemnifies the supplier for claims other than those caused by Veridian's own breach

preferred: Confidentiality survives at least 5 years after the agreement ends
Laws of India; exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Mumbai
fallback: Laws of India; arbitration seated in India under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996
red_line: Any law other than Indian law

preferred: Veridian may terminate for convenience on no more than 30 days' notice
red_line: No right for Veridian to terminate for convenience, or more than 90 days' notice

preferred: Payment within 60 days of a valid invoice
condition: Anything shorter than 45 days is a deviation

preferred: Compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and breach notification within 72 hours
condition: Notification later than 7 days, or none, is a deviation

preferred: All deliverables and their IP belong to Veridian on creation
fallback: Supplier keeps IP but grants Veridian a perpetual, royalty-free, irrevocable licence
red_line: Supplier keeps all IP with no licence, or only a time-limited licence, to Veridian

preferred: Veridian may audit on 15 days' notice
condition: Required only where the counterparty's risk tier is high

preferred: No subcontracting without Veridian's prior written consent
fallback: Subcontracting allowed with 15 days' prior written notice
condition: Subcontracting without consent or notice is a deviation

preferred: Professional indemnity insurance of at least ₹5 crore
condition: Required only where the annual value is more than ₹1 crore
